remarks_1999: Not recorded Abiquiú Notebooks. Whitney Archive indicates, "Painted ab. 1923. O'Keeffe thinks two 'Leaves' sold to Mrs. Sterns. They may be w.c." Backing inscriptions date 1924. Dated 1923 on basis of inclusion in 1924 New York (Anderson) exhibition and Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. Pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 24. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
